about: The current version of the terms of use and the minimum age for an account (F-14).

Laravel reads this file at sign-up (api/app/Support/Legal.php): a registration is accepted only with exactly this terms version and a confirmation of exactly this minimum age, and the account stores both with the time of the confirmation.
The container smoke (.github/workflows/docker.yml) reads it for its sign-up payloads.

Named mirrors in the app, which cannot import JSON in its unit tests: LEGAL_VERSION in src/domain/legal.ts and MIN_AGE in src/constants/operator.ts. src/domain/legal.test.ts fails when either differs from this file.

A new terms version is a change to the legal texts in src/domain/legal.ts: change both places in the same commit. How age is verified beyond this confirmation is an operator decision and not made here.
